title: The Mourners
text: Hired mourners wail at a barrow no one has visited in centuries, tearing at robes gone to cobweb, their voices thin as wind. They are still waiting to be paid. They look at you with hope.

options.label: Pay them for their centuries of grief, so they may finally rest.

outcomes.text: At last they fall silent and fade. The quiet over the barrow feels like thanks.

options.label: The steadiest voice mourns beside them, learning the old lament.

outcomes.text: They teach the lament nobody sings any more. It lingers in the throat for days.

options.label: Drive them off; the dead have no use for coin, and neither do their mourners.

outcomes.text: They wail louder. The barrow wakes to see why.
